subject: CAIQ instrumentation evidence and runtime proof — next steps
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cedarpointlabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security_ops@cedarpointlabs.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: runtime instrumentation + tenant isolation evidence ask

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our internal review we need a compact CAIQ submission focused on runtime instrumentation and tenant isolation controls (particularly around KV cache, prefixing, and request-level telemetry). The assessor team wants: 

- A control mapping (CSV) that points CAIQ questions to Redwood control IDs and where evidence lives.
- One or two short runtime telemetry snippets (last 30 days) showing tenant scoping and KV cache behavior (redacted).
- A short narrative (1 page) on how fallbacks / model routing maintain isolation in Dedicated/Private modes.
- A signed acknowledgement (DocuSign) confirming the artifacts are complete for their intake.

Can you confirm what you can provide by end of week? We prefer artifacts uploaded to a shared Drive link and a DocuSign for the acknowledgement. I've attached the assessor's intake template (cedarpoint_caiq_template.xlsx) so you can see the expected columns.

Appreciate it — we need to close the intake window by 9/20.

Best,
Elaine Park
Security & Privacy, CedarPoint Labs

Attachment: cedarpoint_caiq_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cedarpointlabs.com>
Cc: security_ops@cedarpointlabs.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: runtime instrumentation + tenant isolation evidence ask

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can provide the requested artifacts; plan below and ETA: EOD 9/16 for the bundle and DocuSign link for acknowledgement the same day.

Planned deliverables:
- CAIQ control mapping CSV (caiq_control_map_cedarpoint_v1.csv): maps each CAIQ question to Redwood control IDs, evidence file names and short notes on scope.
- Runtime telemetry snippet (runtime-telemetry-snippet-20260914.txt): redacted lines showing tenant identifiers and KV cache key prefixes.
- KV cache example (kv_cache_sample.json): small synthetic extract demonstrating prefixing and TTLs.
- 1-page narrative on routing/fallbacks: how Dedicated + Private maintain isolation and what automated fallbacks look like.
- DocuSign acknowledgement: I will send the embedded DocuSign link for signature once artifacts are staged in Drive.

Internal owners: looping in Marissa (evidence curation), Priyom (CAIQ mapping & annotations), and David (runtime logs extraction). Marissa — can you coordinate the Drive upload and confirm redaction before DocuSign? Priyom/David — see inline asks below.

If anything in the assessor template needs clarification we'll flag it before staging.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: CAIQ instrumentation — evidence packaging (internal)

Team — short sprint to assemble artifacts for CedarPoint. Elaine's intake window closes 9/20 so tight timeline. Tasks: 

- Marissa: Package the Drive folder under /internal/cedarpoint/caiq-pack, include a README that lists artifacts and redaction approach. Confirm link perms (viewer + request access for CedarPoint). Upload attachments: caiq_control_map_cedarpoint_v1.csv, runtime-telemetry-snippet-20260914.txt, kv_cache_sample.json, DocuSign-CAIQ-acknowledgement.pdf (placeholder).

- Priyom: Populate the mapping CSV. Key columns: CAIQ id, Redwood control id, evidence filename, owner, short note on control implementation. Mark any partials that need follow-up. ETA: EOD 9/15.

- David: Pull a redacted runtime snippet (last 30 days) scoped to tenant id prefix cedarpoint-* showing KV cache set/get behavior and the routing decision log around fallback events. Redact full UUIDs and IPs; leave short tokenized tenant identifiers. Attach runtime-telemetry-snippet-20260914.txt and kv_cache_sample.json. ETA: EOD 9/16.

Two practical points: 1) Keep the telemetry snippets minimal (20–50 lines) — assessors don't need full logs. 2) Ensure no PII or customer data is present — if you find anything that might be considered customer content, redact and note the redaction in the README.

I'll coordinate the DocuSign once artifacts are staged. Ping me in Slack if blocked.

Thanks — Jasmine

Attachment stubs: caiq_control_map_cedarpoint_v1.csv (CSV), runtime-telemetry-snippet-20260914.txt (text), kv_cache_sample.json (json)
